sections.title: Breakfast at the hotel, the loch by mid-morning
sections.html:
Strathclyde Country Park lies along the Clyde between Motherwell and Hamilton, about a mile from our door. At its heart is the loch, used for watersports and ringed by woodland walks, where the triathlon of the 2014 Commonwealth Games was held. In the park are the remains of a Roman fort and bathhouse, and on its edge sit M&D’s, Scotland’s theme park, and Amazonia, an indoor tropical house, about 2 miles from the hotel.

In the other direction, about a mile to the south, is Dalzell Estate, with Dalzell House, its Japanese gardens, an arboretum and five waymarked routes, and beside it the RSPB’s Baron’s Haugh reserve, where hides look over wetland known for kingfishers and otters. Next door to the hotel, the North Lanarkshire Heritage Centre is free to visit and has a viewing tower over the Clyde Valley. A few miles further on are Chatelherault Country Park, with its hunting lodge of 1734, and Hamilton Park Racecourse.

Back at the hotel, parking is free and the restaurant and bar are under the same roof for the evening. Every room is en suite, with a TV, tea and coffee making facilities and free WiFi. Our family room sleeps up to three, one of whom may be a child, and in the morning breakfast is a full Scottish, cooked to order.

sections.title: Visiting the park: what people ask us

items.q: How far is Strathclyde Country Park from the hotel?
items.a: About a mile. It’s a short drive, or a walk of 15 to 20 minutes, and parking at the hotel is free, so you can leave the car with us if you prefer.

items.q: How far is M&D's theme park?
items.a: About 2 miles. M&D’s and Amazonia sit on the edge of Strathclyde Country Park, so they’re easy to combine with a walk by the loch.

Yes. Our family room has a double bed and a single bed and sleeps up to three guests, one of whom may be a child. If you need a cot or an extra bed, or two rooms near each other, call us on 01698 265588 before you book.
Pets can’t stay at the hotel, but assistance animals are welcome. Let us know when you book so we can be ready for you.

items.q: Can we leave bags before check-in or after check-out?
items.a: Check-in is from 2pm and check-out by 11am. If you’re arriving early for a day out, or leaving late, ask us about leaving your bags with us while you make the most of the day.
